verdicts.statement: A misdemeanor is a crime punishable by a maximum county jail sentence of six months or one year.
verdicts.reason: The context explicitly states that a misdemeanor has a maximum punishment of either six months or one year in a county jail.

verdicts.statement: Most misdemeanors are punishable by a fine of up to $1,000.
verdicts.reason: The context lists a $1,000 fine as a maximum punishment for most misdemeanors.
